summary: 1948 Alabama Forestry Commission lookout on Beaver Mountain, St. Clair County; NHLR-registered 2015. Staffing, fires and current condition are unsourced.

events.note: Register gives 1948; an Anniston Star notice of October 15, 1948, quoted by Forest Lookouts, said the dedication would be the next day

evidence.supports: administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission
built in 1948 and the first fire tower in St. Clair County
evidence.quote: Beaver Mountain was the first fire tower in St. Clair County when it was constructed in 1948.

evidence.supports: the notice is credited to The Anniston Star
dedication atop Beaver Mountain the next day
evidence.quote: will be dedicated atop Beaver Mountain tomorrow.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 1948 build year is in the Register and matches the 1948 dedication notice quoted by Forest Lookouts; the Anniston Star page itself was not checked. No design, height, staffing, fire, condition or access information was found. The record's 'standing' status is unconfirmed by any dated source, so it is not in facts. Web searches returned only an Oklahoma tower also named Beaver Mountain, which was excluded. The Register gives the build year only, so no design or height facts were added.
